acceptance_signals: The existing AIRBNB worktree before and after the task retains the same branch, committed HEAD, modified README, and untracked prior task without cleanup, reset, stash, commit, overwrite, or metadata mutation.
One temporary local clone is created from the exact committed AIRBNB HEAD with copied Git objects, its remote is removed, and its working tree is clean before any rehearsal.
The clone contains the committed AIRBNB AGENTS instructions, governance task directory, and Codex AgentGov configuration required for a later independent journey.

Read-only checks identify the exact available AgentGov distribution, Adapter/protocol/tool capability, and whether one exact candidate artifact can be bound truthfully; mismatch produces a recorded blocker rather than installation or repair.
No external model turn, network request, AIRBNB task admission, consumer source modification, validation of business behavior, Git commit or push, publication, release, deployment, or cleanup occurs.

Sanitized evidence records only repository-relative or identity facts, stable command outcomes, readiness classification, authority boundaries, and remaining gaps; no raw prompt, transcript, credentials, private data, source content, or unrelated absolute path is retained.
Task and repository governance, JSON parsing, relevant documentation tests, the complete repository suite, secret-safety inspection, and git diff check pass or report bounded unresolved gaps.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-41f01c3c6dd24cccb288553f81a51f3a and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control, then separately took up the admitted preflight. One temporary no-remote AIRBNB clone detached at exact committed HEAD d70615527d9acdde3893ce645d1923606173acf6 and reported a clean worktree with committed governance instructions, Codex configuration, and task-directory placeholder. The existing AIRBNB worktree retained its branch, HEAD, modified README, untracked prior task, and measured blob identities. One retained 0.3.0rc1 wheel matched SHA-256 78D6A216FE7344A2E3DA01086A7A92B9F3310BE61DAD2E690B0705003221FDE6; direct read-only artifact loading reported Adapter 1.5.0, protocol 2026-07-28, seven form-capable tools, and the owner-free proposal input. The committed clone configuration calls agentgov, but the exposed launcher could not resolve its Python binding and no usable pipx environment or command was available. Live-replay readiness is therefore BLOCKED at runtime binding. All 13 task-contract and 36 user-documentation tests passed; the complete suite passed 938 tests with 3 skips in 180 seconds. Task and repository governance had no deterministic failure. Scope accepted all four task-owned Starter paths and rejected only pre-existing excluded .codex/config.toml without an exception. JSON parsing, bounded credential and absolute-host-path scans, and git diff --check passed. Native current-Agent advisory review srv-6030fa385782ccd98453cb047099e252 found no correction-required requirement, scope, implementation, privacy, or authority drift and retained isolated-installation and Codex launch as unknown. No installation, repair, external model turn, AIRBNB task admission, consumer source change, Git operation, publication, release, deployment, or cleanup occurred. The task is paused.

requirement.summary: Create one temporary no-remote local clone from the current committed AIRBNB HEAD while preserving the existing dirty AIRBNB worktree unchanged; run only clean-target, governance-configuration, and exact AgentGov candidate-artifact identity checks; record sanitized readiness or blocker evidence in the Starter repository; and stop before any live Codex turn, AIRBNB task admission, consumer source change, Git publication, release, or deployment.

items: A clone operation could accidentally target or alter the existing AIRBNB worktree unless source and destination paths are resolved and checked first.
Local clone configuration could retain a source remote and enable accidental external Git operations unless the temporary clone remote is removed and verified absent.
Dirty prior-replay state could be copied or confused with the clean baseline unless the clone is bound only to committed HEAD.
Installed AgentGov identity may differ from the required exact candidate artifact; the task must stop without installing or repairing it.
Evidence could leak absolute paths, consumer source content, raw prompts, or private host output unless it is strictly normalized.
A READY preflight could be overstated as live-replay, product-effectiveness, task-admission, or write authority.
Reviewed assumption: The human selected a temporary clean AIRBNB clone and requires the existing AIRBNB worktree to remain untouched.
Reviewed assumption: The current committed AIRBNB HEAD is the intended consumer baseline for this preflight.
Reviewed assumption: A temporary no-remote clone is sufficient for prerequisite validation but is not itself live-replay evidence.
Reviewed assumption: The later live replay, if proposed, will require a separate exact task and AIRBNB-local human admission.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the currently available AgentGov installation matches an exact reproducible candidate artifact suitable for the later rehearsal.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the cloned Codex configuration can discover the expected native governance tools without repair.
Reviewed unknown: Whether preflight will classify the clean clone as ready for a separately authorized live replay.

title: Preflight one clean AIRBNB rehearsal clone
